title: WordCount job had map tasks killed and re-run
description: Several map tasks of a WordCount MapReduce job were killed partway through and had to run again, so the job finished late.

groundTruth.cause: One cluster node (04DN8IQ) went down, so YARN marked it unusable and killed the map attempts running on it, which were then re-run on other nodes.
goodNextSteps: Check whether node 04DN8IQ is up (ping, NodeManager status in the ResourceManager UI or `yarn node -list -all`)
Check that node's NodeManager and system logs for why it went down

notes: Loghub Hadoop run with an injected machine-down failure. The evidence is only in INFO lines (no ERROR, and the WARN lines are unrelated noise), so it tests whether the app can find a cause outside errors and warnings.
